ios.desc:
CypherChat® - Secure Communication That Puts You First

Looking for an encrypted messaging app that keeps your conversations 100% private? With CypherChat®, your privacy is always the priority. No data collection. No tracking. No compromises.

Why CypherChat®?

True Anonymity: No phone number. No email. Zero personal data collected.

AES 256-bit Encryption: End-to-end encrypted (E2EE) chats for maximum security.

Zero Data Tracking: We never sell your data or monitor your conversations.

Patent-Pending Technology: Privacy innovations built for people who refuse to compromise.

KEY FEATURES

Anonymous Sign-Up
Create your account without sharing any personal information. No phone number. No email. No identity required.

AskCyph™ AI Assistant
Your built-in AI chatbot for instant answers and content generation. Create, edit, and analyze images directly in your chat. Browse the web, visit sites, and run deep research without ever leaving the app.

DocCyph™: AI Productivity
Upload PDFs to instantly extract key points and generate automated summaries. Work smarter, not harder.

P2P Encrypted Video Calls
Crystal-clear HD voice and video calls with zero central servers. Includes screen sharing and custom virtual backgrounds for a fully private conferencing experience.

Secure File Sharing
Send documents, images, and videos with end-to-end encryption. Fast, unlimited peer-to-peer transfers with absolute privacy and no leaks.

Private Group Chats
Create highly secure groups for friends, family, or business teams. All group conversations are fully encrypted and completely anonymous.

Custom Privacy & Disappearing Messages
Choose between High, Medium, or Low privacy settings. Send no-trace disappearing messages that vanish with zero digital footprint.

Secure Invites
Grow your network instantly via secure invite links or QR codes with custom expiration dates. Only the right people get in.

Built-In Games
Play with friends or challenge AI without ever leaving your chat. Choose from a growing library of classic games including Chess, Checkers, Connect 4, Tic-Tac-Toe, Battleship, Reversi, Hangman, Word Chain, Minesweeper, Wordle, 2048, Sudoku, Dots & Boxes, Hex, Go, Tower of Hanoi, Ludo, UNO, Texas Hold'em, and more!

WHO IS CYPHERCHAT FOR?

Business Professionals requiring secure corporate collaboration

Journalists and Activists protecting sensitive sources

Everyday Users who demand privacy in their personal lives

Privacy by Design

CypherChat® was built on the belief

Introducing CypherChat a next-generation End-to-End Encrypted (E2EE) and Peer-to-Peer (P2P) messaging platform that believes in your right to privacy and expression. The platform does not rely upon personal information, not even on sign-up. It’s Free Try Now!

Check out Product Hunt to learn more about the product, how we are different, what are the use cases, and share your feedback.
